title: Talking About Our Jobs
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Hello, Lina. What do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I am a nurse in a small hospital.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you like your job?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, I like helping people.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What time do you start work?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I start at eight in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: And when do you finish?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I finish at four in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل تعملين في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Sometimes. Hospitals are always busy.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What is your job, Adam?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I work in a bookstore.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, I love books and talking to customers.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، أحب الكتب والتحدث مع الزبائن.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you sell books for children?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, and we sell books for adults too.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What time does the bookstore open?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: It opens at ten in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I want to buy a book next week.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Come and visit me at the store!
